no_kyc_track._note: Cards marketed as no-KYC / low-KYC, from discovery articles (cardpilled 2026-09-23, cryptoslate 2026-10-22). Nothing here is verified. Inclusion rule (brief §5): a card enters the catalogue only if the issuer or operator is named, official terms state the verification stage and limits, and the product is active. Anonymous-by-design prepaid cards with undisclosed issuers fail that rule; 'no initial KYC with thresholds' can pass.
